SELECT sc.id, sc.code, sc.approve_status, sc.approve_user_name, sc.create_user_name, sc.create_time, scd.sku_id, scd.sku_no, scd.old_qty, scd.qty, scd.old_price, scd.price, scd.old_amount, scd.amount, scd.old_tax_rate, scd.tax_rate, scd.old_currency, scd.currency, scd.currency_symbol, scd.old_currency_symbol, scd.so_detail_id FROM so_change sc INNER JOIN so_change_detail scd ON sc.id=scd.main_id AND scd.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE sc.is_deleted=FALSE AND sc.so_id=#{soId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
